verses.kjv: Then said Joab to Cushi, Go tell the king what thou hast seen. And Cushi bowed himself unto Joab, and ran.
verses.decoded: Then Joab said to Cushi, Go tell the king what you have seen. And Cushi bowed to Joab and ran.

verses.kjv: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok yet again to Joab, But howsoever, let me, I pray thee, also run after Cushi. And Joab said, Wherefore wilt thou run, my son, seeing that thou hast no tidings ready?
verses.decoded: Then Ahimaaz, the son of Zadok, said again to Joab, "But please, let me also run after Cushi." And Joab said, "Why do you want to run, my son, since you have no news ready?"

verses.kjv: But howsoever, said he, let me run. And he said unto him, Run. Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the plain, and overran Cushi.
verses.decoded: But anyway, he said, let me run. And he said to him, Run. Then Ahimaaz ran along the road through the plain and passed Cushi.

verses.kjv: And David sat between the two gates: and the watchman went up to the roof over the gate unto the wall, and lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold a man running alone.
verses.decoded: David was sitting between the two gates, and the watchman went up to the roof above the gate on the wall, raised his eyes, looked, and saw a man running alone.

verses.kjv: And the watchman cried, and told the king. And the king said, If he be alone, there is tidings in his mouth. And he came apace, and drew near.
verses.decoded: The watchman shouted and told the king. The king said, If he is alone, then he has news to share. The man came quickly and got closer.

verses.kjv: And the watchman saw another man running: and the watchman called unto the porter, and said, Behold another man running alone. And the king said, He also bringeth tidings.
verses.decoded: The watchman saw another man running and called to the gatekeeper, saying, 'Look, another man is running alone.' The king said, 'He is also bringing news.'

verses.kjv: And the watchman said, Me thinketh the running of the foremost is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok. And the king said, He is a good man, and cometh with good tidings.
verses.decoded: And the watchman said, I think the runner in front is running like Ahimaaz, the son of Zadok. And the king said, He is a good man, and he is coming with good news.

verses.kjv: And Ahimaaz called, and said unto the king, All is well. And he fell down to the earth upon his face before the king, and said, Blessed be the Lord thy God, which hath delivered up the men that lifted up their hand against my lord the king.
verses.decoded: And Ahimaaz called out and said to the king, Everything is fine. Then he fell face down on the ground before the king and said, Blessed be the LORD your God, who has handed over the men who raised their hand against my lord the king.

verses.kjv: And the king said, Is the young man Absalom safe? And Ahimaaz answered, When Joab sent the king’s servant, and me thy servant, I saw a great tumult, but I knew not what it was.
verses.decoded: The king asked, Is the young man Absalom safe? Ahimaaz answered, When Joab sent the king’s servant and me, your servant, I saw a great commotion, but I did not know what it was.

verses.kjv: And the king said unto him, Turn aside, and stand here. And he turned aside, and stood still.
verses.decoded: And the king said to him, Turn aside and stand here. And he turned aside and stood still.

verses.kjv: And, behold, Cushi came; and Cushi said, Tidings, my lord the king: for the Lord hath avenged thee this day of all them that rose up against thee.
verses.decoded: Then Cushi arrived and said, News, my lord the king: because the LORD has taken revenge for you today against all those who rebelled against you.

verses.kjv: And the king said unto Cushi, Is the young man Absalom safe? And Cushi answered, The enemies of my lord the king, and all that rise against thee to do thee hurt, be as that young man is.
verses.decoded: And the king said to Cushi, Is the young man Absalom safe? And Cushi answered, May the enemies of my lord the king, and all who rise against you to harm you, be like that young man.

verses.kjv: And the king was much moved, and went up to the chamber over the gate, and wept: and as he went, thus he said, O my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom! would God I had died for thee, O Absalom, my son, my son!
verses.decoded: The king was deeply upset, and he went up to the room above the gate and cried. As he went, he said, "Oh my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom! I wish I had died instead of you, Absalom, my son, my son!"

verses.kjv: And it was told Joab, Behold, the king weepeth and mourneth for Absalom.
verses.decoded: And it was reported to Joab, Look, the king is crying and grieving for Absalom.

verses.kjv: And the victory that day was turned into mourning unto all the people: for the people heard say that day how the king was grieved for his son.
verses.decoded: And the victory that day turned into sadness for all the people because the people heard that day how the king was deeply upset for his son.

verses.kjv: And the people gat them by stealth that day into the city, as people being ashamed steal away when they flee in battle.
verses.decoded: And the people quietly went into the city that day, like people who are ashamed and sneak away when they run away in battle.

verses.kjv: But the king covered his face, and the king cried with a loud voice, O my son Absalom, O Absalom, my son, my son!
verses.decoded: But the king covered his face, and the king cried out loudly, "Oh my son Absalom, oh Absalom, my son, my son!"

verses.kjv: And Joab came into the house to the king, and said, Thou hast shamed this day the faces of all thy servants, which this day have saved thy life, and the lives of thy sons and of thy daughters, and the lives of thy wives, and the lives of thy concubines;
verses.decoded: And Joab came into the house to the king and said, You have brought shame today to all your servants who have saved your life today, and the lives of your sons and your daughters, and the lives of your wives, and the lives of your concubines;

verses.kjv: In that thou lovest thine enemies, and hatest thy friends. For thou hast declared this day, that thou regardest neither princes nor servants: for this day I perceive, that if Absalom had lived, and all we had died this day, then it had pleased thee well.
verses.decoded: Because you love your enemies and hate your friends. For you have declared today that you do not care about princes or servants; for today I realize that if Absalom had lived and all of us had died today, then that would have pleased you well.

verses.kjv: Now therefore arise, go forth, and speak comfortably unto thy servants: for I swear by the Lord, if thou go not forth, there will not tarry one with thee this night: and that will be worse unto thee than all the evil that befell thee from thy youth until now.
verses.decoded: So now get up, go out, and speak kindly to your servants, because I swear by the LORD, if you do not go out, not one will stay with you tonight; and that will be worse for you than all the troubles that have happened to you from your youth until now.

verses.kjv: Then the king arose, and sat in the gate. And they told unto all the people, saying, Behold, the king doth sit in the gate. And all the people came before the king: for Israel had fled every man to his tent.
verses.decoded: Then the king stood up and sat at the city gate. They told all the people, saying, Look, the king is sitting at the gate. And all the people came to the king, because Israel had each fled to his own home.

verses.kjv: And all the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, The king saved us out of the hand of our enemies, and he delivered us out of the hand of the Philistines; and now he is fled out of the land for Absalom.
verses.decoded: And all the people were arguing throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, The king saved us from the hand of our enemies, and he rescued us from the hand of the Philistines; and now he has fled the land because of Absalom.

verses.kjv: And Absalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle. Now therefore why speak ye not a word of bringing the king back?
verses.decoded: And Absalom, whom we appointed as our leader, is dead in battle. So why are you not saying anything about bringing the king back?

verses.kjv: And king David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, Speak unto the elders of Judah, saying, Why are ye the last to bring the king back to his house? seeing the speech of all Israel is come to the king, even to his house.
verses.decoded: And King David sent to Zadok and Abiathar the priests, saying, Speak to the elders of Judah, saying, Why are you the last to bring the king back to his house? Since the message from all Israel has reached the king, even to his house.

verses.kjv: Ye are my brethren, ye are my bones and my flesh: wherefore then are ye the last to bring back the king?
verses.decoded: You are my brothers, you are my own flesh and blood: so why are you the last to bring back the king?

verses.kjv: And say ye to Amasa, Art thou not of my bone, and of my flesh? God do so to me, and more also, if thou be not captain of the host before me continually in the room of Joab.
verses.decoded: And tell Amasa, Aren't you part of my family and flesh? May God do to me the same and even more if you are not the commander of the army before me always instead of Joab.

verses.kjv: And he bowed the heart of all the men of Judah, even as the heart of one man; so that they sent this word unto the king, Return thou, and all thy servants.
verses.decoded: He united the hearts of all the men of Judah as if they were one person; so they sent this message to the king, "Come back, you and all your servants."

verses.kjv: So the king returned, and came to Jordan. And Judah came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to conduct the king over Jordan.
verses.decoded: So the king came back and arrived at the Jordan River. And the people of Judah went to Gilgal to meet the king and to guide him across the Jordan River.

verses.kjv: And Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite, which was of Bahurim, hasted and came down with the men of Judah to meet king David.
verses.decoded: Shimei, the son of Gera, a Benjamite from Bahurim, hurried and came down with the men of Judah to meet King David.

verses.kjv: And there were a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of the house of Saul, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went over Jordan before the king.
verses.decoded: There were a thousand men from Benjamin with him, along with Ziba, the servant of Saul's household, and Ziba's fifteen sons and twenty servants; they crossed the Jordan River ahead of the king.

verses.kjv: And there went over a ferry boat to carry over the king’s household, and to do what he thought good. And Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king, as he was come over Jordan;
verses.decoded: A ferry boat crossed to bring the king’s household across, and to do whatever he wanted. Shimei, the son of Gera, fell down before the king as he came across the Jordan River;

verses.kjv: And said unto the king, Let not my lord impute iniquity unto me, neither do thou remember that which thy servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart.
verses.decoded: And said to the king, Please do not hold my lord guilty, and do not remember what your servant did wrong on the day that my lord the king left Jerusalem, so that the king would not take it to heart.

verses.kjv: For thy servant doth know that I have sinned: therefore, behold, I am come the first this day of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king.
verses.decoded: For your servant knows that I have sinned; therefore, I have come today before anyone else from all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king.

verses.kjv: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered and said, Shall not Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the Lord’s anointed?
verses.decoded: But Abishai, the son of Zeruiah, answered and said, Shouldn't Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the LORD'S anointed?

verses.kjv: And David said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah, that ye should this day be adversaries unto me? shall there any man be put to death this day in Israel? for do not I know that I am this day king over Israel?
verses.decoded: And David said, What do I have to do with you, sons of Zeruiah, that you should be enemies to me today? Will anyone be put to death today in Israel? Do I not know that I am king over Israel today?

verses.kjv: Therefore the king said unto Shimei, Thou shalt not die. And the king sware unto him.
verses.decoded: Therefore the king said to Shimei, You will not die. And the king swore to him.

verses.kjv: And Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king, and had neither dressed his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes, from the day the king departed until the day he came again in peace.
verses.decoded: Mephibosheth, the son of Saul, came down to meet the king, and he had not cleaned his feet, trimmed his beard, or washed his clothes from the day the king left until the day he returned safely.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when he was come to Jerusalem to meet the king, that the king said unto him, Wherefore wentest not thou with me, Mephibosheth?
verses.decoded: When he arrived in Jerusalem to meet the king, the king said to him, "Why did you not go with me, Mephibosheth?"

verses.kjv: And he answered, My lord, O king, my servant deceived me: for thy servant said, I will saddle me an ass, that I may ride thereon, and go to the king; because thy servant is lame.
verses.decoded: And he answered, My lord, O king, my servant tricked me: because your servant said, I will saddle a donkey for myself, so that I can ride on it and go to the king; because your servant is lame.

verses.kjv: And he hath slandered thy servant unto my lord the king; but my lord the king is as an angel of God: do therefore what is good in thine eyes.
verses.decoded: And he has spoken badly about your servant to my lord the king; but my lord the king is like an angel of God: so do what is good in your eyes.

verses.kjv: For all of my father’s house were but dead men before my lord the king: yet didst thou set thy servant among them that did eat at thine own table. What right therefore have I yet to cry any more unto the king?
verses.decoded: Because all of my father's family were like dead men before my lord the king, yet you placed your servant among those who ate at your own table. So what reason do I have left to appeal to the king?

verses.kjv: And the king said unto him, Why speakest thou any more of thy matters? I have said, Thou and Ziba divide the land.
verses.decoded: And the king said to him, Why do you keep talking about your issues? I have said, You and Ziba will divide the land.

verses.kjv: And Mephibosheth said unto the king, Yea, let him take all, forasmuch as my lord the king is come again in peace unto his own house.
verses.decoded: And Mephibosheth said to the king, Yes, let him take everything, since my lord the king has returned safely to his own home.

verses.kjv: And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim, and went over Jordan with the king, to conduct him over Jordan.
verses.decoded: And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim and crossed the Jordan River with the king to guide him across the Jordan.

verses.kjv: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even fourscore years old: and he had provided the king of sustenance while he lay at Mahanaim; for he was a very great man.
verses.decoded: Now Barzillai was a very old man, eighty years old; and he had provided food for the king while he stayed at Mahanaim, because he was a very important man.

verses.kjv: And the king said unto Barzillai, Come thou over with me, and I will feed thee with me in Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: And the king said to Barzillai, Come with me, and I will provide for you with me in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And Barzillai said unto the king, How long have I to live, that I should go up with the king unto Jerusalem?
verses.decoded: And Barzillai said to the king, How much longer do I have to live that I should go up with the king to Jerusalem?

verses.kjv: I am this day fourscore years old: and can I discern between good and evil? can thy servant taste what I eat or what I drink? can I hear any more the voice of singing men and singing women? wherefore then should thy servant be yet a burden unto my lord the king?
verses.decoded: I am eighty years old today: and can I tell the difference between good and evil? Can your servant taste what I eat or what I drink? Can I hear the voices of singing men and singing women anymore? So why should your servant still be a burden to my lord the king?

verses.kjv: Thy servant will go a little way over Jordan with the king: and why should the king recompense it me with such a reward?
verses.decoded: Your servant will go a short distance across the Jordan with the king, so why should the king repay me with such a reward?

verses.kjv: Let thy servant, I pray thee, turn back again, that I may die in mine own city, and be buried by the grave of my father and of my mother. But behold thy servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord the king; and do to him what shall seem good unto thee.
verses.decoded: Please allow your servant to return again so that I may die in my own city and be buried beside the grave of my father and mother. But here is your servant Chimham; let him go with my lord the king, and do to him whatever seems good to you.

verses.kjv: And the king answered, Chimham shall go over with me, and I will do to him that which shall seem good unto thee: and whatsoever thou shalt require of me, that will I do for thee.
verses.decoded: And the king answered, Chimham will go with me, and I will do to him whatever seems good to you; and whatever you ask of me, I will do for you.

verses.kjv: And all the people went over Jordan. And when the king was come over, the king kissed Barzillai, and blessed him; and he returned unto his own place.
verses.decoded: All the people crossed the Jordan River. When the king had crossed, he kissed Barzillai and blessed him; then Barzillai returned to his own home.

verses.kjv: Then the king went on to Gilgal, and Chimham went on with him: and all the people of Judah conducted the king, and also half the people of Israel.
verses.decoded: Then the king continued to Gilgal, and Chimham went with him; all the people of Judah escorted the king, along with half the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And, behold, all the men of Israel came to the king, and said unto the king, Why have our brethren the men of Judah stolen thee away, and have brought the king, and his household, and all David’s men with him, over Jordan?
verses.decoded: And look, all the men of Israel came to the king and said to the king, Why have our brothers, the men of Judah, taken you away and brought the king, his household, and all of David’s men with him, across the Jordan?

verses.kjv: And all the men of Judah answered the men of Israel, Because the king is near of kin to us: wherefore then be ye angry for this matter? have we eaten at all of the king’s cost? or hath he given us any gift?
verses.decoded: And all the men of Judah answered the men of Israel, Because the king is closely related to us: so why are you angry about this? Have we eaten anything at the king’s expense? Or has he given us any gift?

verses.kjv: And the men of Israel answered the men of Judah, and said, We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more right in David than ye: why then did ye despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king? And the words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel.
verses.decoded: The men of Israel responded to the men of Judah and said, "We have ten shares in the king, and we also have more claim to David than you do. So why did you reject us, refusing to consider our advice first when bringing back our king?" The words of the men of Judah were harsher than the words of the men of Israel.

verses.kjv: And there happened to be there a man of Belial, whose name was Sheba, the son of Bichri, a Benjamite: and he blew a trumpet, and said, We have no part in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to his tents, O Israel.
verses.decoded: There was a worthless man there named Sheba, the son of Bichri, a Benjamite. He blew a trumpet and said, "We have no part with David, and we have no inheritance with the son of Jesse. Everyone go to your own homes, Israel!"

verses.kjv: So every man of Israel went up from after David, and followed Sheba the son of Bichri: but the men of Judah clave unto their king, from Jordan even to Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: So every man from Israel left David and followed Sheba the son of Bichri, but the men of Judah remained loyal to their king, from the Jordan River all the way to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten women his concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in ward, and fed them, but went not in unto them. So they were shut up unto the day of their death, living in widowhood.
verses.decoded: David returned to his house in Jerusalem; the king took the ten women who were his concubines, whom he had left to take care of the house, and put them under guard and provided for them, but did not have relations with them. They remained confined until the day they died, living as widows.

verses.kjv: Then said the king to Amasa, Assemble me the men of Judah within three days, and be thou here present.
verses.decoded: Then the king said to Amasa, Gather the men of Judah for me within three days, and be here with me.

verses.kjv: So Amasa went to assemble the men of Judah: but he tarried longer than the set time which he had appointed him.
verses.decoded: So Amasa went to gather the men of Judah, but he took longer than the time he had been given.

verses.kjv: And David said to Abishai, Now shall Sheba the son of Bichri do us more harm than did Absalom: take thou thy lord’s servants, and pursue after him, lest he get him fenced cities, and escape us.
verses.decoded: And David said to Abishai, Now Sheba son of Bichri will harm us more than Absalom did: take your lord’s servants and chase after him, so he does not get fortified cities and escape from us.

verses.kjv: And there went out after him Joab’s men, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and all the mighty men: and they went out of Jerusalem, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.
verses.decoded: Joab’s men, along with the Cherethites, the Pelethites, and all the strong warriors, went out of Jerusalem to chase after Sheba, the son of Bichri.

verses.kjv: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa went before them. And Joab’s garment that he had put on was girded unto him, and upon it a girdle with a sword fastened upon his loins in the sheath thereof; and as he went forth it fell out.
verses.decoded: When they reached the large stone in Gibeon, Amasa led them. Joab was wearing a garment that was tied around him, and over it a belt with a sword fastened to his waist in its sheath; as he walked forward, the sword fell out.

verses.kjv: And Joab said to Amasa, Art thou in health, my brother? And Joab took Amasa by the beard with the right hand to kiss him.
verses.decoded: And Joab said to Amasa, Are you well, my brother? And Joab grabbed Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him.

verses.kjv: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab’s hand: so he smote him therewith in the fifth rib, and shed out his bowels to the ground, and struck him not again; and he died. So Joab and Abishai his brother pursued after Sheba the son of Bichri.
verses.decoded: But Amasa did not pay attention to the sword that was in Joab’s hand, so Joab struck him with it in the fifth rib, causing his intestines to spill onto the ground. Joab did not strike him again, and Amasa died. Then Joab and his brother Abishai chased after Sheba, the son of Bichri.

verses.kjv: And one of Joab’s men stood by him, and said, He that favoureth Joab, and he that is for David, let him go after Joab.
verses.decoded: One of Joab’s men stood beside him and said, Anyone who supports Joab and is loyal to David, follow Joab.

verses.kjv: And Amasa wallowed in blood in the midst of the highway. And when the man saw that all the people stood still, he removed Amasa out of the highway into the field, and cast a cloth upon him, when he saw that every one that came by him stood still.
verses.decoded: Amasa was lying in blood in the middle of the road. When the man saw that everyone had stopped, he took Amasa off the road into the field and covered him with a cloth, because he saw that everyone who passed by had stopped.

verses.kjv: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.
verses.decoded: When he was taken off the road, all the people continued following Joab to chase after Sheba the son of Bichri.

verses.kjv: And he went through all the tribes of Israel unto Abel, and to Beth-maachah, and all the Berites: and they were gathered together, and went also after him.
verses.decoded: He traveled through all the tribes of Israel to Abel, to Beth-maachah, and to all the people of Berite; they gathered together and followed him.

verses.kjv: And they came and besieged him in Abel of Beth-maachah, and they cast up a bank against the city, and it stood in the trench: and all the people that were with Joab battered the wall, to throw it down.
verses.decoded: They came and surrounded him in Abel of Beth-maachah, and they built a ramp against the city, which was next to the trench; and all the people with Joab attacked the wall to break it down.

verses.kjv: Then cried a wise woman out of the city, Hear, hear; say, I pray you, unto Joab, Come near hither, that I may speak with thee.
verses.decoded: Then a wise woman called out from the city, Listen, listen; please say to Joab, Come close here, so that I can speak with you.

verses.kjv: And when he was come near unto her, the woman said, Art thou Joab? And he answered, I am he. Then she said unto him, Hear the words of thine handmaid. And he answered, I do hear.
verses.decoded: When he came near her, the woman said, "Are you Joab?" He answered, "I am." Then she said to him, "Listen to the words of your servant woman." He replied, "I am listening."

verses.kjv: Then she spake, saying, They were wont to speak in old time, saying, They shall surely ask counsel at Abel: and so they ended the matter.
verses.decoded: Then she spoke, saying, People used to say long ago, 'They will definitely ask for advice at Abel,' and that is how they resolved the issue.

verses.kjv: I am one of them that are peaceable and faithful in Israel: thou seekest to destroy a city and a mother in Israel: why wilt thou swallow up the inheritance of the Lord?
verses.decoded: I am one of those who are peaceful and loyal in Israel: you are trying to destroy a city and a mother in Israel: why do you want to take away the inheritance that belongs to the LORD?

verses.kjv: And Joab answered and said, Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.
verses.decoded: And Joab answered and said, It is completely unacceptable for me to take everything or to destroy.

verses.kjv: The matter is not so: but a man of mount Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, hath lifted up his hand against the king, even against David: deliver him only, and I will depart from the city. And the woman said unto Joab, Behold, his head shall be thrown to thee over the wall.
verses.decoded: That is not the case: but a man from Mount Ephraim, named Sheba son of Bichri, has rebelled against the king, even against David. Hand him over alone, and I will leave the city. And the woman said to Joab, Look, his head will be thrown to you over the wall.

verses.kjv: Then the woman went unto all the people in her wisdom. And they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and cast it out to Joab. And he blew a trumpet, and they retired from the city, every man to his tent. And Joab returned to Jerusalem unto the king.
verses.decoded: Then the woman went to all the people wisely. They cut off the head of Sheba, the son of Bichri, and threw it out to Joab. Joab blew a trumpet, and the people left the city, each man going to his own tent. Then Joab returned to Jerusalem to the king.

verses.kjv: Now Joab was over all the host of Israel: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites:
verses.decoded: Joab was in charge of the entire army of Israel, and Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, was in charge of the Cherethites and the Pelethites.

verses.kjv: And Adoram was over the tribute: and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder:
verses.decoded: Adoram was in charge of the tribute, and Jehoshaphat, the son of Ahilud, was the recorder.

verses.kjv: And Sheva was scribe: and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests:
verses.decoded: Sheva was the secretary, and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests.

verses.kjv: And Ira also the Jairite was a chief ruler about David.
verses.decoded: Ira, who was from the family of Jair, was also a chief officer serving under David.

verses.kjv: Then there was a famine in the days of David three years, year after year; and David inquired of the Lord. And the Lord answered, It is for Saul, and for his bloody house, because he slew the Gibeonites.
verses.decoded: Then there was a famine during the time of David for three years in a row; and David asked the LORD about it. The LORD answered, It is because of Saul and his violent family, because he killed the Gibeonites.

verses.kjv: And the king called the Gibeonites, and said unto them; (now the Gibeonites were not of the children of Israel, but of the remnant of the Amorites; and the children of Israel had sworn unto them: and Saul sought to slay them in his zeal to the children of Israel and Judah.)
verses.decoded: And the king called the Gibeonites and said to them; (now the Gibeonites were not from the children of Israel, but were from the remaining Amorites; and the children of Israel had made a promise to them: and Saul tried to kill them because of his zeal for the children of Israel and Judah.)

verses.kjv: Wherefore David said unto the Gibeonites, What shall I do for you? and wherewith shall I make the atonement, that ye may bless the inheritance of the Lord?
verses.decoded: Therefore David asked the Gibeonites, What can I do for you? How can I make amends so that you will bless the LORD's inheritance?

verses.kjv: And the Gibeonites said unto him, We will have no silver nor gold of Saul, nor of his house; neither for us shalt thou kill any man in Israel. And he said, What ye shall say, that will I do for you.
verses.decoded: And the Gibeonites said to him, We do not want silver or gold from Saul or his family; nor should you kill any man in Israel for us. And he said, Whatever you say, I will do for you.

verses.kjv: And they answered the king, The man that consumed us, and that devised against us that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the coasts of Israel,
verses.decoded: And they answered the king, The man who destroyed us and planned against us so that we would be wiped out from all the territories of Israel,

verses.kjv: Let seven men of his sons be delivered unto us, and we will hang them up unto the Lord in Gibeah of Saul, whom the Lord did choose. And the king said, I will give them.
verses.decoded: Let seven of his sons be handed over to us, and we will hang them before the LORD in Gibeah of Saul, whom the LORD chose. And the king said, I will give them.

verses.kjv: But the king spared Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of the Lord’s oath that was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.
verses.decoded: But the king spared Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, who was the son of Saul, because of the LORD’S promise that was between David and Jonathan, the son of Saul.

verses.kjv: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bare unto Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul, whom she brought up for Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite:
verses.decoded: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah, whom she gave birth to with Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Michal, the daughter of Saul, whom she raised for Adriel, the son of Barzillai the Meholathite:

verses.kjv: And he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them in the hill before the Lord: and they fell all seven together, and were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days, in the beginning of barley harvest.
verses.decoded: He handed them over to the Gibeonites, and they hanged them on the hill in front of the LORD. All seven of them died together during the harvest season, at the very beginning of the barley harvest.

verses.kjv: And Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth, and spread it for her upon the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water dropped upon them out of heaven, and suffered neither the birds of the air to rest on them by day, nor the beasts of the field by night.
verses.decoded: And Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah, took sackcloth and spread it out for herself on the rock, from the beginning of the harvest until water fell on them from the sky, and she did not allow the birds of the air to rest on them during the day, nor the wild animals to come near them at night.

verses.kjv: And it was told David what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.
verses.decoded: David was informed about what Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah and Saul's concubine, had done.

verses.kjv: And David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabesh-gilead, which had stolen them from the street of Beth-shan, where the Philistines had hanged them, when the Philistines had slain Saul in Gilboa:
verses.decoded: David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabesh-gilead. These men had taken the bones from the street of Beth-shan, where the Philistines had hung them after killing Saul in Gilboa.

verses.kjv: And he brought up from thence the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son; and they gathered the bones of them that were hanged.
verses.decoded: He brought up the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from there; and they gathered the bones of those who had been hanged.

verses.kjv: And the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son buried they in the country of Benjamin in Zelah, in the sepulchre of Kish his father: and they performed all that the king commanded. And after that God was intreated for the land.
verses.decoded: They buried the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son in the land of Benjamin, in Zelah, in the tomb of Kish his father. They did everything the king commanded. After that, God was asked to forgive the land.

verses.kjv: Moreover the Philistines had yet war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines: and David waxed faint.
verses.decoded: The Philistines fought against Israel again, and David went down with his servants and fought against the Philistines. David became exhausted.

verses.kjv: And Ishbi-benob, which was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear weighed three hundred shekels of brass in weight, he being girded with a new sword, thought to have slain David.
verses.decoded: And Ishbi-benob, who was one of the descendants of the giant, whose spear weighed three hundred shekels of bronze, and who was wearing a new sword, planned to kill David.

verses.kjv: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah succoured him, and smote the Philistine, and killed him. Then the men of David sware unto him, saying, Thou shalt go no more out with us to battle, that thou quench not the light of Israel.
verses.decoded: But Abishai, the son of Zeruiah, helped him and struck down the Philistine and killed him. Then David's men made him swear, saying, You will no longer go out with us to battle, so that you do not extinguish the light of Israel.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass after this, that there was again a battle with the Philistines at Gob: then Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Saph, which was of the sons of the giant.
verses.decoded: After this, there was another battle with the Philistines at Gob. Then Sibbechai the Hushathite killed Saph, who was one of the descendants of the giant.

verses.kjv: And there was again a battle in Gob with the Philistines, where Elhanan the son of Jaare-oregim, a Beth-lehemite, slew the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.
verses.decoded: There was another battle at Gob against the Philistines, where Elhanan, the son of Jaare-oregim, a man from Bethlehem, killed the brother of Goliath from Gath, whose spear shaft was as large as a weaver’s beam.

verses.kjv: And there was yet a battle in Gath, where was a man of great stature, that had on every hand six fingers, and on every foot six toes, four and twenty in number; and he also was born to the giant.
verses.decoded: There was another battle in Gath, where there was a man of great height who had six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot, twenty-four in total; and he was also born to the giant.

verses.kjv: And when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea the brother of David slew him.
verses.decoded: And when he challenged Israel, Jonathan, the son of Shimeah, David's brother, killed him.

verses.kjv: These four were born to the giant in Gath, and fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.
verses.decoded: These four were born to the giant in Gath, and were killed by David and by his servants.

verses.kjv: And David spake unto the Lord the words of this song in the day that the Lord had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul:
verses.decoded: And David spoke to the LORD the words of this song on the day the LORD had rescued him from the power of all his enemies and from the power of Saul.

verses.kjv: And he said, The Lord is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;
verses.decoded: And he said, The LORD is my solid foundation, my strong protection, and my rescuer;

verses.kjv: The God of my rock; in him will I trust: he is my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge, my saviour; thou savest me from violence.
verses.decoded: The God who is my rock; I will trust in him: he is my shield, the strength of my salvation, my strong tower, my refuge, my savior; you save me from violence.

verses.kjv: I will call on the Lord, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.
verses.decoded: I will call on the LORD, who deserves to be praised; then I will be saved from my enemies.

verses.kjv: When the waves of death compassed me, the floods of ungodly men made me afraid;
verses.decoded: When the dangers of death surrounded me, the overwhelming attacks of wicked people terrified me;

verses.kjv: The sorrows of hell compassed me about; the snares of death prevented me;
verses.decoded: The troubles of the grave surrounded me; the traps of death stopped me;

verses.kjv: In my distress I called upon the Lord, and cried to my God: and he did hear my voice out of his temple, and my cry did enter into his ears.
verses.decoded: In my trouble I called to the LORD, and cried out to my God; and he heard my voice from his temple, and my cry reached his ears.

verses.kjv: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations of heaven moved and shook, because he was wroth.
verses.decoded: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations of heaven moved and shook because he was angry.

verses.kjv: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.
verses.decoded: Smoke came out of his nostrils, and fire came out of his mouth and burned; glowing coals were set on fire by it.

verses.kjv: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; and darkness was under his feet.
verses.decoded: He bent the sky and came down; darkness was beneath his feet.

verses.kjv: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: and he was seen upon the wings of the wind.
verses.decoded: And he rode on a cherub and flew; he was seen on the wings of the wind.

verses.kjv: And he made darkness pavilions round about him, dark waters, and thick clouds of the skies.
verses.decoded: And he made darkness like tents all around him, deep waters, and thick clouds in the sky.

verses.kjv: Through the brightness before him were coals of fire kindled.
verses.decoded: In the brightness in front of him, burning coals of fire were ignited.

verses.kjv: The Lord thundered from heaven, and the most High uttered his voice.
verses.decoded: The LORD thundered from heaven, and the Most High spoke with his voice.

verses.kjv: And he sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and discomfited them.
verses.decoded: He shot arrows and scattered them; he sent lightning and defeated them.

verses.kjv: And the channels of the sea appeared, the foundations of the world were discovered, at the rebuking of the Lord, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.
verses.decoded: The ocean's depths became visible, the foundations of the earth were uncovered, when the LORD rebuked, with the blast of the breath from his nostrils.

verses.kjv: He sent from above, he took me; he drew me out of many waters;
verses.decoded: He sent help from above, he rescued me; he pulled me out of many deep waters;

verses.kjv: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me.
verses.decoded: He rescued me from my powerful enemy and from those who hated me because they were too strong for me.

verses.kjv: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the Lord was my stay.
verses.decoded: They stopped me on the day of my trouble, but the LORD was my support.

verses.kjv: He brought me forth also into a large place: he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
verses.decoded: He also brought me out into a spacious place; he rescued me because he was pleased with me.

verses.kjv: The Lord rewarded me according to my righteousness: according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.
verses.decoded: The LORD rewarded me based on my righteousness; he repaid me according to the purity of my actions.

verses.kjv: For I have kept the ways of the Lord, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
verses.decoded: Because I have followed the ways of the LORD and have not turned away from my God in a wrong way.

verses.kjv: For all his judgments were before me: and as for his statutes, I did not depart from them.
verses.decoded: Because all his laws were in front of me, and I did not turn away from his rules.

verses.kjv: I was also upright before him, and have kept myself from mine iniquity.
verses.decoded: I was also honest before him, and I have kept myself from my sin.

verses.kjv: Therefore the Lord hath recompensed me according to my righteousness; according to my cleanness in his eye sight.
verses.decoded: Therefore the LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to my purity in his sight.

verses.kjv: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful, and with the upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright.
verses.decoded: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful, and with the upright person you will show yourself upright.

verses.kjv: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself unsavoury.
verses.decoded: With the pure you will show yourself pure; and with the twisted you will show yourself unpleasant.

verses.kjv: And the afflicted people thou wilt save: but thine eyes are upon the haughty, that thou mayest bring them down.
verses.decoded: And you will save the oppressed people, but your eyes are on the proud so that you may bring them down.

verses.kjv: For thou art my lamp, O Lord: and the Lord will lighten my darkness.
verses.decoded: For you are my lamp, O LORD, and the LORD will brighten my darkness.

verses.kjv: For by thee I have run through a troop: by my God have I leaped over a wall.
verses.decoded: Because of you, I have run through a group of enemies; because of my God, I have jumped over a wall.

verses.kjv: As for God, his way is perfect; the word of the Lord is tried: he is a buckler to all them that trust in him.
verses.decoded: As for God, his way is flawless; the word of the LORD has been tested; he is a shield to all who trust in him.

verses.kjv: For who is God, save the Lord? and who is a rock, save our God?
verses.decoded: For who is God except the LORD? And who is a rock except our God?

verses.kjv: God is my strength and power: and he maketh my way perfect.
verses.decoded: God is my strength and power, and he makes my path perfect.

verses.kjv: He maketh my feet like hinds’ feet: and setteth me upon my high places.
verses.decoded: He makes my feet like the feet of a deer and sets me securely on high places.

verses.kjv: He teacheth my hands to war; so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.
verses.decoded: He teaches my hands to fight; so that a steel bow is broken by my arms.

verses.kjv: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy gentleness hath made me great.
verses.decoded: You have also given me the shield of your salvation, and your kindness has made me great.

verses.kjv: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; so that my feet did not slip.
verses.decoded: You have made my steps firm beneath me so that my feet did not slip.

verses.kjv: I have pursued mine enemies, and destroyed them; and turned not again until I had consumed them.
verses.decoded: I have chased my enemies and destroyed them; I did not turn back until I had completely defeated them.

verses.kjv: And I have consumed them, and wounded them, that they could not arise: yea, they are fallen under my feet.
verses.decoded: I have destroyed them and injured them so they could not get up; yes, they have fallen under my feet.

verses.kjv: For thou hast girded me with strength to battle: them that rose up against me hast thou subdued under me.
verses.decoded: For you have given me strength to fight; those who stood against me you have brought under my control.

verses.kjv: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies, that I might destroy them that hate me.
verses.decoded: You have also given me the necks of my enemies, so that I can destroy those who hate me.

verses.kjv: They looked, but there was none to save; even unto the Lord, but he answered them not.
verses.decoded: They looked around, but there was no one to save them; even when they called to the LORD, he did not answer them.

verses.kjv: Then did I beat them as small as the dust of the earth, I did stamp them as the mire of the street, and did spread them abroad.
verses.decoded: Then I defeated them completely, as small as the dust on the ground; I crushed them like the mud in the street and scattered them everywhere.

verses.kjv: Thou also hast delivered me from the strivings of my people, thou hast kept me to be head of the heathen: a people which I knew not shall serve me.
verses.decoded: You also have saved me from the conflicts of my people; you have allowed me to be the leader of the nations. People I did not know will serve me.

verses.kjv: Strangers shall submit themselves unto me: as soon as they hear, they shall be obedient unto me.
verses.decoded: Foreigners will submit to me; as soon as they hear, they will obey me.

verses.kjv: Strangers shall fade away, and they shall be afraid out of their close places.
verses.decoded: Foreigners will disappear, and they will be terrified in their hiding places.

verses.kjv: The Lord liveth; and blessed be my rock; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation.
verses.decoded: The LORD lives; and may my rock be blessed; and may the God who is the rock of my salvation be highly honored.

verses.kjv: It is God that avengeth me, and that bringeth down the people under me,
verses.decoded: It is God who takes revenge for me and who makes the people under me fall.

verses.kjv: And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies: thou also hast lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.
verses.decoded: And that brings me out from my enemies: you also have lifted me up high above those who stood against me: you have saved me from the violent man.

verses.kjv: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee, O Lord, among the heathen, and I will sing praises unto thy name.
verses.decoded: Therefore I will give thanks to you, O LORD, among the nations, and I will sing praises to your name.

verses.kjv: He is the tower of salvation for his king: and sheweth mercy to his anointed, unto David, and to his seed for evermore.
verses.decoded: He is the strong tower that saves his king and shows kindness to his chosen one, to David and to his descendants forever.

verses.kjv: Now these be the last words of David. David the son of Jesse said, and the man who was raised up on high, the anointed of the God of Jacob, and the sweet psalmist of Israel, said,
verses.decoded: These are the final words of David. David, the son of Jesse, said, and the man who was exalted, the chosen one of the God of Jacob, and the beloved singer of Israel, said,

verses.kjv: The Spirit of the Lord spake by me, and his word was in my tongue.
verses.decoded: The Spirit of the LORD spoke through me, and his word was on my tongue.

verses.kjv: The God of Israel said, the Rock of Israel spake to me, He that ruleth over men must be just, ruling in the fear of God.
verses.decoded: The God of Israel said, the Rock of Israel spoke to me, The one who rules over people must be fair, ruling with respect for God.

verses.kjv: And he shall be as the light of the morning, when the sun riseth, even a morning without clouds; as the tender grass springing out of the earth by clear shining after rain.
verses.decoded: He will be like the light of the morning when the sun rises, a morning without clouds; like the tender grass growing from the earth after the clear shining following rain.

verses.kjv: Although my house be not so with God; yet he hath made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things, and sure: for this is all my salvation, and all my desire, although he make it not to grow.
verses.decoded: Even though my family is not like this with God, he has made an eternal agreement with me, established in every detail and certain; because this is all my salvation and all my desire, even if he does not cause it to increase.

verses.kjv: But the sons of Belial shall be all of them as thorns thrust away, because they cannot be taken with hands:
verses.decoded: But worthless people will all be like thorns that are pushed aside because they cannot be grabbed by hand.

verses.kjv: But the man that shall touch them must be fenced with iron and the staff of a spear; and they shall be utterly burned with fire in the same place.
verses.decoded: But the man who touches them must be protected with iron and the shaft of a spear; and they will be completely burned with fire in that same place.

verses.kjv: These be the names of the mighty men whom David had: The Tachmonite that sat in the seat, chief among the captains; the same was Adino the Eznite: he lift up his spear against eight hundred, whom he slew at one time.
verses.decoded: These are the names of the mighty men who belonged to David: The Tachmonite who sat in the seat, the chief among the captains; he was Adino the Eznite: he raised his spear against eight hundred men, whom he killed at one time.

verses.kjv: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo the Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David, when they defied the Philistines that were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel were gone away:
verses.decoded: After him was Eleazar, the son of Dodo the Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David, when they challenged the Philistines who had gathered there for battle, and the men of Israel had retreated.

verses.kjv: He arose, and smote the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand clave unto the sword: and the Lord wrought a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to spoil.
verses.decoded: He got up and struck the Philistines until his hand was tired, and his hand stuck to the sword; and the LORD brought about a great victory that day; and the people followed him only to take the spoils.

verses.kjv: And after him was Shammah the son of Agee the Hararite. And the Philistines were gathered together into a troop, where was a piece of ground full of lentiles: and the people fled from the Philistines.
verses.decoded: After him was Shammah, the son of Agee, the Hararite. The Philistines gathered together in a group at a field full of lentils, and the people ran away from the Philistines.

verses.kjv: But he stood in the midst of the ground, and defended it, and slew the Philistines: and the Lord wrought a great victory.
verses.decoded: But he stood in the middle of the field, defended it, and killed the Philistines; and the LORD brought about a great victory.

verses.kjv: And three of the thirty chief went down, and came to David in the harvest time unto the cave of Adullam: and the troop of the Philistines pitched in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.decoded: Three of the thirty leaders went down and came to David during the harvest time at the cave of Adullam. Meanwhile, the Philistine army camped in the valley of Rephaim.

verses.kjv: And David was then in an hold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Beth-lehem.
verses.decoded: At that time, David was in a stronghold, and the Philistine soldiers were stationed in Bethlehem.

verses.kjv: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Beth-lehem, which is by the gate!
verses.decoded: And David was very thirsty and said, I wish someone would give me a drink of water from the well in Bethlehem, near the city gate!

verses.kjv: And the three mighty men brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Beth-lehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: nevertheless he would not drink thereof, but poured it out unto the Lord.
verses.decoded: And the three mighty men broke through the army of the Philistines, drew water from the well of Bethlehem, which was by the gate, took it, and brought it to David; however, he would not drink it, but poured it out as an offering to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And he said, Be it far from me, O Lord, that I should do this: is not this the blood of the men that went in jeopardy of their lives? therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mighty men.
verses.decoded: And he said, Far be it from me, Lord, to do this: is this not the blood of the men who risked their lives? Therefore, he refused to drink it. These things were done by these three mighty men.

verses.kjv: And Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief among three. And he lifted up his spear against three hundred, and slew them, and had the name among three.
verses.decoded: Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was the leader of three men. He raised his spear against three hundred men, killed them, and became famous among those three.

verses.kjv: Was he not most honourable of three? therefore he was their captain: howbeit he attained not unto the first three.
verses.decoded: Was he not the most honorable of the three? Therefore, he was their leader; however, he did not reach the level of the first three.

verses.kjv: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man, of Kabzeel, who had done many acts, he slew two lionlike men of Moab: he went down also and slew a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow:
verses.decoded: Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, the son of a brave man from Kabzeel, who had done many great deeds, killed two strong men from Moab who were like lions. He also went down and killed a lion inside a pit during the snowy season.

verses.kjv: And he slew an Egyptian, a goodly man: and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and slew him with his own spear.
verses.decoded: He killed an Egyptian, a strong man; the Egyptian had a spear in his hand, but he approached him with a staff, took the spear from the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.

verses.kjv: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among three mighty men.
verses.decoded: Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, did these things and was known as one of the three mighty men.

verses.kjv: He was more honourable than the thirty, but he attained not to the first three. And David set him over his guard.
verses.decoded: He was more honorable than the thirty, but he did not reach the level of the first three. And David put him in charge of his bodyguard.

verses.kjv: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty; Elhanan the son of Dodo of Beth-lehem,
verses.decoded: Asahel, the brother of Joab, was one of the thirty; Elhanan, the son of Dodo from Bethlehem,

verses.kjv: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,
verses.decoded: Shammah from Harod, Elika from Harod,

verses.kjv: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,
verses.decoded: Helez from Paltite, Ira, the son of Ikkesh from Tekoite,

verses.kjv: Abiezer the Anethothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,
verses.decoded: Abiezer from Anethoth, Mebunnai from Hushah,

verses.kjv: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,
verses.decoded: Zalmon from Ahoah, Maharai from Netophah,

verses.kjv: Heleb the son of Baanah, a Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai out of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,
verses.decoded: Heleb, the son of Baanah, a man from Netophah, Ittai, the son of Ribai, from Gibeah among the descendants of Benjamin,

verses.kjv: Benaiah the Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash,
verses.decoded: Benaiah from Pirathon, Hiddai from the streams of Gaash,

verses.kjv: Abi-albon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,
verses.decoded: Abi-albon from Arbath, Azmaveth from Barhum,

verses.kjv: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, of the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,
verses.decoded: Eliahba from Shaalbon, one of the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,

verses.kjv: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Hararite,
verses.decoded: Shammah from Harar, Ahiam, the son of Sharar from Harar,

verses.kjv: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maachathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,
verses.decoded: Eliphelet, the son of Ahasbai, who was the son of the Maachathite; Eliam, the son of Ahithophel, the Gilonite,

verses.kjv: Hezrai the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,
verses.decoded: Hezrai from Carmel, Paarai from Arbit,

verses.kjv: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,
verses.decoded: Igal, the son of Nathan from Zobah, Bani from the tribe of Gad,

verses.kjv: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, armourbearer to Joab the son of Zeruiah,
verses.decoded: Zelek the Ammonite, Nahari the Beerothite, the armor-bearer to Joab, the son of Zeruiah,

verses.kjv: Ira an Ithrite, Gareb an Ithrite,
verses.decoded: Ira from Ithrite, Gareb from Ithrite,

verses.kjv: Uriah the Hittite: thirty and seven in all.
verses.decoded: Uriah the Hittite: thirty-seven in total.

verses.kjv: And again the anger of the Lord was kindled against Israel, and he moved David against them to say, Go, number Israel and Judah.
verses.decoded: Once again, the LORD's anger was aroused against Israel, and he caused David to act against them by saying, 'Go, count the people of Israel and Judah.'

verses.kjv: For the king said to Joab the captain of the host, which was with him, Go now through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, and number ye the people, that I may know the number of the people.
verses.decoded: The king said to Joab, the commander of the army, who was with him, "Go now through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan to Beer-sheba, and count the people, so that I may know the number of the people."

verses.kjv: And Joab said unto the king, Now the Lord thy God add unto the people, how many soever they be, an hundredfold, and that the eyes of my lord the king may see it: but why doth my lord the king delight in this thing?
verses.decoded: And Joab said to the king, May the LORD your God increase the people, however many there are, a hundred times over, so that my lord the king's eyes may see it; but why does my lord the king take pleasure in this matter?

verses.kjv: Notwithstanding the king’s word prevailed against Joab, and against the captains of the host. And Joab and the captains of the host went out from the presence of the king, to number the people of Israel.
verses.decoded: However, the king’s command was stronger than Joab and the commanders of the army. So Joab and the commanders left the king’s presence to count the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And they passed over Jordan, and pitched in Aroer, on the right side of the city that lieth in the midst of the river of Gad, and toward Jazer:
verses.decoded: They crossed the Jordan River and camped in Aroer, on the right side of the city that is located in the middle of the river of Gad, near Jazer.

verses.kjv: Then they came to Gilead, and to the land of Tahtim-hodshi; and they came to Dan-jaan, and about to Zidon,
verses.decoded: Then they went to Gilead, and to the land of Tahtim-hodshi; and they went to Dan-jaan, and near to Zidon,

verses.kjv: And came to the strong hold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hivites, and of the Canaanites: and they went out to the south of Judah, even to Beer-sheba.
verses.decoded: They came to the fortress of Tyre and to all the cities of the Hivites and the Canaanites, and they went out to the southern part of Judah, all the way to Beer-sheba.

verses.kjv: So when they had gone through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.
verses.decoded: After they had traveled through the entire land, they arrived in Jerusalem after nine months and twenty days.

verses.kjv: And Joab gave up the sum of the number of the people unto the king: and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew the sword; and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.
verses.decoded: Joab reported the total number of the people to the king: there were eight hundred thousand brave men in Israel who were soldiers, and five hundred thousand men in Judah.

verses.kjv: And David’s heart smote him after that he had numbered the people. And David said unto the Lord, I have sinned greatly in that I have done: and now, I beseech thee, O Lord, take away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.
verses.decoded: David felt guilty after he had counted the people. Then David said to the LORD, I have sinned greatly by what I have done; now, I ask you, O LORD, please remove the guilt of your servant, because I have acted very foolishly.

verses.kjv: For when David was up in the morning, the word of the Lord came unto the prophet Gad, David’s seer, saying,
verses.decoded: When David got up in the morning, the message from the LORD came to the prophet Gad, who was David’s seer, saying,

verses.kjv: Go and say unto David, Thus saith the Lord, I offer thee three things; choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.
verses.decoded: Go and tell David, This is what the LORD says, I am offering you three options; choose one of them, and I will do it for you.

verses.kjv: So Gad came to David, and told him, and said unto him, Shall seven years of famine come unto thee in thy land? or wilt thou flee three months before thine enemies, while they pursue thee? or that there be three days’ pestilence in thy land? now advise, and see what answer I shall return to him that sent me.
verses.decoded: So Gad came to David, told him, and said to him, Will seven years of famine come to your land? Or will you flee for three months before your enemies while they chase you? Or will there be a three-day plague in your land? Now decide, and see what answer I should give to the one who sent me.

verses.kjv: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let us fall now into the hand of the Lord; for his mercies are great: and let me not fall into the hand of man.
verses.decoded: And David said to Gad, I am in a serious situation: let us now fall into the hand of the LORD, because his mercies are great; and do not let me fall into the hand of humans.

verses.kjv: So the Lord sent a pestilence upon Israel from the morning even to the time appointed: and there died of the people from Dan even to Beer-sheba seventy thousand men.
verses.decoded: So the LORD sent a plague on Israel from the morning until the set time, and seventy thousand men died among the people from Dan to Beer-sheba.

verses.kjv: And when the angel stretched out his hand upon Jerusalem to destroy it, the Lord repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed the people, It is enough: stay now thine hand. And the angel of the Lord was by the threshingplace of Araunah the Jebusite.
verses.decoded: When the angel reached out his hand to destroy Jerusalem, the LORD changed his mind about the disaster and said to the angel who was destroying the people, "That is enough; stop now your hand." The angel of the LORD was at the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

verses.kjv: And David spake unto the Lord when he saw the angel that smote the people, and said, Lo, I have sinned, and I have done wickedly: but these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, be against me, and against my father’s house.
verses.decoded: And David spoke to the LORD when he saw the angel who was striking the people, and said, Look, I have sinned, and I have done wrong: but these sheep, what have they done? Let your hand, I pray, be against me and against my father’s house.

verses.kjv: And Gad came that day to David, and said unto him, Go up, rear an altar unto the Lord in the threshingfloor of Araunah the Jebusite.
verses.decoded: And Gad came that day to David and said to him, Go up, build an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

verses.kjv: And David, according to the saying of Gad, went up as the Lord commanded.
verses.decoded: And David, following the message from Gad, went up as the LORD commanded.

verses.kjv: And Araunah looked, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him: and Araunah went out, and bowed himself before the king on his face upon the ground.
verses.decoded: Araunah looked and saw the king and his servants coming toward him, so Araunah went out and bowed down before the king, face down on the ground.

verses.kjv: And Araunah said, Wherefore is my lord the king come to his servant? And David said, To buy the threshingfloor of thee, to build an altar unto the Lord, that the plague may be stayed from the people.
verses.decoded: And Araunah said, Why has my lord the king come to his servant? And David said, To buy your threshing floor to build an altar to the LORD, so that the plague may be stopped from the people.

verses.kjv: And Araunah said unto David, Let my lord the king take and offer up what seemeth good unto him: behold, here be oxen for burnt sacrifice, and threshing instruments and other instruments of the oxen for wood.
verses.decoded: And Araunah said to David, Let my lord the king take and offer whatever seems good to him: look, here are oxen for burnt offerings, and threshing tools and other tools from the oxen for wood.

verses.kjv: All these things did Araunah, as a king, give unto the king. And Araunah said unto the king, The Lord thy God accept thee.
verses.decoded: All these things did Araunah, as a king, give to the king. And Araunah said to the king, May the LORD your God accept you.

verses.kjv: And the king said unto Araunah, Nay; but I will surely buy it of thee at a price: neither will I offer burnt offerings unto the Lord my God of that which doth cost me nothing. So David bought the threshingfloor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.
verses.decoded: And the king said to Araunah, No; but I will definitely buy it from you at a price: I will not offer burnt offerings to the LORD my God from something that costs me nothing. So David bought the threshing floor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.

verses.kjv: And David built there an altar unto the Lord, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. So the Lord was intreated for the land, and the plague was stayed from Israel.
verses.decoded: And David built an altar there to the LORD, and he offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. Then the LORD was asked to be merciful to the land, and the plague was stopped from Israel.
